quizName: Hardest Questions in Massachusetts Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?
questions.explanation: Use a turn signal every time you turn or change lanes. Do this even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: When your turn is obvious, should you use a turn signal?
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes. Your intentions may seem obvious to you, but other drivers may not see you or may not notice. Use signals every time, no matter what.

questions.question: What do goggles protect?

options.text: As much as a face shield.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes. A face shield is better because it protects your whole face. A windshield does not provide enough protection.

questions.question: How do you know if a motorcycle fits you?

options.text: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars are above your head.
Your feet don't rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly if your feet can touch the ground while you are sitting. You should be able to reach and operate all the controls easily.

questions.question: What is dangerous about riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
Other drivers may drive slowly while looking for parking.
The road surface may be uneven.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
questions.explanation: A car door may open into your lane, or a driver may pull out without looking. Pedestrians may also step out from between cars.

questions.question: Where should you find information about your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual for your specific motorcycle before you ride it. This is especially important if you are borrowing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do if a drunk friend wants to ride their motorcycle?

options.text: Tell them to use quiet roads.

questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have been drinking. Do whatever you can to stop them, including taking their keys. Find them another way to get home.

questions.question: Why should you wear riding gloves?

options.text: Don't wear them; they make your hands too hot.
They give you a better grip on the handlebars.
Don't wear them; they make controls harder to use.
Wear them only on cool days.

questions.correctAnswerText: They give you a better grip on the handlebars.
questions.explanation: Wear leather gloves or gloves made of durable material. They improve your grip and protect your hands in a crash.

questions.question: Which fabric protects a motorcyclist the most?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection for riders.

questions.question: Which item is not protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves when riding.

questions.question: If you wear laced footwear while riding, the laces should:
questions.explanation: Tuck in your shoelaces while riding so they don't get caught on your motorcycle.

questions.question: What is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is fastened securely is the best way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Be part of your normal scanning routine.
Be avoided because they distract you.
Be avoided because other drivers will see you.
Only be done in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly to know what is behind you. Mirror checks should be part of your normal scanning routine for safety.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Only be done on long trips.
Be part of your normal scanning routine.
Not be done since you cannot change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly as part of your normal scanning routine. Also check them before changing lanes, at intersections, and before slowing down.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, wear clothing that:

options.text: Covers your arms and legs completely.
Covers your arms but leaves your legs exposed.
Covers your legs but leaves your arms exposed.
Is comfortable, without regard to safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Covers your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely to protect yourself while riding.

questions.question: Head and neck injuries can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: A good helmet greatly reduces head and neck injuries. It is your best protection in a crash.

questions.question: Which color helps you be seen while riding?
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors like orange, red, yellow, or green to be more visible while riding, regardless of the time of day.

questions.question: Motorcycle signals are:

options.text: Not very important since motorcycles are small.
Very important to tell other drivers what you plan to do.
Not needed if no vehicles are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Very important to tell other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Always use your turn signals to alert other drivers to your plans. Use them when changing lanes or turning, even if you think no one is nearby. This is important for your safety.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Is usually too warm to wear while riding.
Should not be worn while riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket while riding for protection. Even in warm weather, a leather jacket can protect you and help prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool.

questions.question: Your main source for information about your motorcycle should be:
questions.explanation: Read your owner's manual for information about your specific motorcycle. It includes details about how to operate your motorcycle and how to maintain it.

questions.question: What happens when you take a corner too fast?

options.text: You may drift into another lane.
It is better than going too slowly.
You will stay in your lane.
It is safe because motorcycles are small.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drift into another lane.
questions.explanation: Taking a corner too fast can cause you to drift into another lane or leave the road. Slow down before you turn.

questions.question: What material are riding gloves usually made from?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a DOT-approved helmet?

options.text: It can greatly reduce head injury in a crash.
It makes it harder to control the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can greatly reduce head injury in a crash.
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not limit your side vision.

questions.question: What types of brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake is more powerful than the rear brake.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding. This includes a sturdy jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, boots that cover and support your ankles, and sturdy gloves.
